title: Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) Inventory Relief on the Northloop Payments Account-Level Reserve
content:
Units a seller holds in Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) reduce the account-level reserve Northloop keeps back from the seller's Northloop Payments on-demand payouts.

**Rule.** The account-level reserve kept back from an on-demand payout is multiplied by one minus the fulfillment relief. The fulfillment relief is 0.50 when the seller's FBN enrollment is active and holds at least 5000 (5,000) units, 0.25 when it is active and holds at least 1000 (1,000) but fewer than 5000 units, and 0 otherwise.

The status of the enrollment and its units on hand are read from the seller's Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) enrollment record.

## Ladder

| FBN enrollment status | Units held | Fulfillment relief | Share of the reserve kept back |
|---|---|---|---|
| active | at least 5000 | 0.50 | one minus 0.50, that is 0.50 |
| active | at least 1000 and fewer than 5000 | 0.25 | 0.75 |
| active | fewer than 1000 | 0 | 1 |
| not active, or no enrollment | any | 0 | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, active enrollment)

- 5000 units: relief 0.50. 4999 units: relief 0.25.
- 1000 units: relief 0.25. 999 units: relief 0.
